runtime.initialise:
set -e
if [ -e "$STACK_DATA_DIR/PG_VERSION" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'The existing PostgreSQL cluster uses an unsupported data layout; preserve it and choose an empty instance directory.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n' "$POSTGRES_ADMIN_PASSWORD" | "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/bin/initdb" --pgdata="$STACK_DATA_DIR/pgdata" --username=stack_admin --auth=scram-sha-256 --pwfile=/dev/stdin --encoding=UTF8 --no-sync
